description: This Python source file implements a Gemini-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion class that handles file uploading, chunking, and metadata management for Gemini's File Search API. It skips embedding as Gemini handles it internally during file upload.

classes.name: GeminiRAGIngestion
classes.description: A class for Gemini-specific RAG ingestion that manages file storage, chunking, and metadata attachment, utilizing Gemini's File Search API.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiRAGIngestion with ingestion options and optional router, setting up model info.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: A method that skips embedding as Gemini handles it internally; returns None.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores files in Gemini's File Search store, creating the store if necessary, and uploading the file content.

methods.name: _create_file_search_store
methods.description: Creates a new Gemini File Search store with a display name.

methods.name: _upload_to_file_search_store
methods.description: Handles resumable upload of a file to Gemini's File Search store.

methods.name: _initiate_resumable_upload
methods.description: Starts a resumable upload session and returns the upload URL.

methods.name: _upload_file_content
methods.description: Uploads the actual file content to the resumable upload URL and returns the file ID.
